get.description: Returns Stamps for the user , company and project

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/viewer_documents/stamps")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

post.description: Saves new stamp for a specific company, project, and document.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

payload = "{\"stamp\":\"string\"}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/viewer_documents/stamps", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
